snippet.title: Saihate Station FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Saihate Station By びぶ/viv All Endings Horror Adventure Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Haru Akinashi and Shion Tatsunami are both 26 years old and work in the same company. Since Haru joined the company two months earlier, Shion calls him "Senpai." They are complete opposites: Shion is cheerful and adept at everything, while Haru is a slow worker who lacks confidence. Feeling inferior, and even a little envious, Haru starts to distance himself from Shion. But a twist of fate brings both of them to Saihate Station, where they make a promise to work together and return home.

Saihate Station: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3079280/Saihate_Station/
Developer: びぶ/viv
Genres: Horror, Adventure
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
